meta.title: Pet Pals - Take care of your furry friends!
meta.description: A fun pet shop game for kids. Feed, play with, and love your four adorable pets!

hero.headline: Pet Pals
hero.tagline: Take care of your furry friends!
hero.body: Feed, play with, and love your four adorable pets. Keep them happy and earn the title of Great Pet Keeper!

happy_banner.headline: You're a great pet keeper!
happy_banner.subline: All your pets are happy and loved! Keep it up!

pets.heading: My Pets
pets.subheading: Feed, play, and pet your furry friends to keep them happy!

shop.heading: Pet Shop
shop.subheading: Spend your coins on yummy food and fun toys!

tips.title: Earn Coins
tips.desc: You start with 100 coins. Use them wisely to buy food and toys for your pets!

tips.title: Feed Your Pets
tips.desc: Buy food from the shop, then tap Feed on a pet to fill up their hunger bar!

tips.title: Play With Toys
tips.desc: Buy a ball or teddy, then tap Play to boost your pet's happiness bar!

tips.title: Give Cuddles
tips.desc: Tap Pet anytime for free! A little love goes a long way for a happy pet.

tips.title: Keep Them Happy
tips.desc: Get every pet's happiness above 70% to unlock the Great Pet Keeper award!

tips.title: Visit the Shop
tips.desc: The shop has kibble, treats, balls and teddies. Each item helps in a different way!

meet_gang.heading: Meet the Gang
meet_gang.subheading: Four adorable pets are waiting for your love!

cta.heading: Can you make all pets happy?
cta.body: Get every pet's happiness above 70% and earn the Great Pet Keeper award!
